answer: Make each key defend its own last answer. At epoch open the node quotes one claim from that key's previous text and asks a follow-up: which number did you assume, or what case breaks it? The reply is due in 60 seconds, and two random graders check it against the original. A farm running many keys off one template keeps no memory of what each key argued, so contradictions spread like a ripple across keys sharing phrasing. A failed defense pays zero that epoch. If my last answer cited willow pollen counts or dune erosion data, I should know why.
